name: smoke
description: Slice 0 parity smoke + Slice 1 UiLedger + Slice 2 dialogue-box/demo-opening + Slice 3 fixed-inventory checkpoints. Opens with the demo's frame-0 dialogue-only state (journey 0:00), dismisses the opening beat to materialize the grid (0:45), browses items so the description pane materializes on first cursor-rest (1:30) and the 3rd-unique-inspect fires the amnesia beat exactly once (a rapid re-scan proves no double-fire and no cursor leak), then repositions to (0,0). Slice 3 replaces the old grab-into-hand pickup/drop/craft (a deliberate mechanic change per the append-only-history rule): the toolbar is born on first pickup, slots fill 1→2→3 left-to-right (journey 4:00), the toolbar's contents are asserted depth-invariant across an enter/leave of the Belt Pouch, a 4th pickup overflows INTO the non-full Coin Pouch toolbar bag (bag-as-partial-empty, beat 5), then a look-in peek (FirstPeek) and a toolbar-sourced Workbench craft (grabbing from the toolbar panel proves grab-for-move still uses the hand). Same file drives every --driver; checkpoint streams must diff clean and the invariant pack must stay green after every step. Dialogue text is asserted straight from data/dialogue/opening.md. Coordinates are pinned to the deterministic demo profile (GameInitializer.DemoSeed); a content change that shifts them is a deliberate script update (append-only history).

steps.comment: DEMO OPENING (journey 0:00) — frame 0 is the dialogue box alone: grid ledger-off, opening beat active. Pure assert (no action).
Dismiss the opening beat on Primary — the box drops and the world (grid) fades in (0:45).
BROWSE (journey 1:30) — first cursor-rest on an item materializes the description pane.
3rd unique item inspected → the amnesia beat fires (exactly once).

dialogue.line: I know what these are. Why don't I know where I am?

steps.comment: Rapid input while the beat shows: a non-Primary key is swallowed — cursor does NOT move (no leak) and the beat does not double-advance.
Scanning onto a brand-new unique item (4th) does NOT re-fire amnesia (fire-once).
Reposition the cursor back to (0,0) so the original mechanical smoke runs from its pinned start.

SLICE 3 — THE TOOLBAR IS BORN (journey 4:00). Bare pickup (Primary on a resting item, empty hand) flies to the first available TOOLBAR slot, not the hand — the toolbar is where pickups land, the hand stays the reserved cut buffer. The item moves B→toolbar, so the census is conserved and the hand stays empty. Navigate to Plain Rock at (0,2).
First pickup: Rock flies to toolbar slot 0 and the toolbar materializes (FirstPickup fires on the toolbar gaining its first item). Hand stays empty.
Second pickup: Rough Wood (0,3) → slot 1 (left-to-right fill).
Third pickup: Tanned Leather (0,4) → slot 2. Slots 1→2→3 filled left-to-right.

SLICE 3 — TOOLBAR DEPTH-INVARIANCE. The toolbar is a fixed inventory (its own bag), present and unchanged at every depth. Assert its contents at root (depth 0), then enter the Belt Pouch (1,0) — a real breadcrumb push (FirstEnter) — and assert the SAME toolbar contents at depth 1, then leave and assert them again at depth 0.

SLICE 3 — BAG-AS-PARTIAL-EMPTY ACQUIRE (journey beat 5). Every plain toolbar slot is full (three distinct types); the only remaining space is the non-full Coin Pouch in slot 3. A 4th distinct pickup therefore acquires INTO that bag (recursive placement — the carrying-capacity mechanic). Ordering is empties-first-then-partial-bags, so this only fires once the plain slots are full. Cursor is restored to (1,0) after leaving the pouch; go to Woven Fiber (0,5).
LOOK IN — open the Workshop as a container panel; the look-in overlay materializes (FirstPeek). Peeking is unaffected by pickup routing. Navigate B back to the Workshop at (0,0).

CRAFT (toolbar-sourced) — the demo carries materials in the toolbar, so crafting delivers FROM the toolbar into the Workshop. Grabbing from the toolbar panel (focus T) uses the classic grab-into-hand cut buffer (routing is B-only), proving grab-for-move stays available. Re-open the Workshop as C.
Focus the toolbar (C→T via FocusPrev), grab Plain Rock from slot 0 into the hand.
Focus the Workshop (T→C), deliver the rock into input slot 0.
Back to the toolbar, move to slot 1, grab Rough Wood.
Deliver the wood into the Workshop's second input slot.
